text:
paul-peopleops: FYI new conversion packet for Mira (intern) — manager requests split sign-on (50% now, 50% after 6mo), waived 1y cliff for first 6mo of RSU vesting, start date flexible (candidate on parental leave wants 9/1). Need policy check and routing.

sarah-recruit: Candidate verbally accepted contingent on flexible start and split sign-on. Wants benefits active from day one of FT employment (9/1).

dan-mgr: Context: Mira owns infra observability work; high retention risk. Proposal: base $128k (L3 near-mid), sign-on $10k split 5k on start, 5k after 6mo (no clawback on final tranche if still employed), and equity 900 RSUs with first 6mo prorated vesting (no full 1y cliff).

paul-peopleops: Wow, cliff waiver is nonstandard. We need committee approval for early vesting or cliff exceptions. Also sign-on split with partial non-clawback needs legal review.

ben-finance: Budget check: base + sign-on = first-year cash depending on timing. Approve routing to exceptions committee if manager justification included. Tag headcount ENG-2026-09-OBS.

payroll-bot: Payroll note: benefits active on 9/1 requires signed offer + HRIS entry by COB Fri prior to pay period. Split sign-on: if second tranche paid later, need tracking for payroll approval.

legal-bot: Legal flags: waiving cliff early can create tax and securities implications. Also splitting sign-on with no clawback on final tranche removes company protection; consider 6-mo repayment on first tranche instead. Need to draft language for split payment and vesting exception.

equity-team: Equity note: we can create a modified grant with accelerated partial vesting for first 6 months but this is unusual. Need equity-committee approval and clear vesting schedule in grant agreement. Also note ISO/NQ tax treatment depending on grant.

talent-ops: Routing plan: recruiting lead -> finance -> people-ops exceptions committee -> equity-team -> legal -> payroll. Please paste manager justification and confirm headcount code.

dan-mgr: Justification: "Mira is sole owner of critical observability pipelines; replacement will take >4 months; competitor outreach active." Headcount ENG-2026-09-OBS. Candidate will start 2026-09-01 (on parental leave now).

paul-peopleops: I'll prepare exception packet. Two discrete asks: 1) split sign-on with second tranche non-clawback; 2) partial waiver of the 1-year cliff for initial 6 months. Committee usually denies cliff waivers but approvals possible with strong justification.

ben-finance: Financial ask: please include cash flow timing for the second tranche and mark hiring premium if sign-on >8% of base. We'll need to amortize for budget.

legal-bot: Draft proposal: allow split sign-on but retain clawback on entire sign-on if employee voluntarily leaves within 6 months of start; alternatively allow second tranche to be earned based on 6-month performance milestone to avoid pure non-clawback. For cliff waiver, include tax counsel note and require equity-committee sign-off.

paul-peopleops: Good. I'll include both options in packet: (A) 50/50 with 6-mo clawback on full sign-on, (B) 50/50 with second tranche earned at 6mo (no clawback). Committee can pick.

talent-ops: Routing started. CC @ben-finance @legal-bot @equity-team. Committee meets tomorrow at 10am.

ben-finance: Preliminary budget OK for option A; option B requires milestone definition for accounting. Approve to committee.

equity-team: We'll need to draft a custom grant for the cliff waiver; expect extra lead time. If candidate insists on 9/1 start, equity team needs final grant terms before that date.

payroll-bot: Reminder: HRIS and signed docs by COB Fri to guarantee 9/1 benefits. Also record of second tranche needs tracking tag for payroll.

dan-mgr: Candidate prefers option B (second tranche earned). If committee approves, I can define a clear milestone: "ownership of observability onboarding of two services and no P1 infra incidents attributable to missing monitoring in first 6 months."

legal-bot: Milestone linkage ok but ensure objective criteria and measurable acceptance. We'll draft language.

paul-peopleops: Packet submitted. Will update with committee decision here. Keep thread short.

talent-ops: Candidate ETA to sign: within 48 hrs of final offer. Will update. :white_check_mark:
